notes: Beef page says cattle live on native forages, irrigated pasture and occasionally some hay. Pigs are raised outdoors on rotated paddocks but most of their diet is non-GMO grain and corn, so pork is pastured, not grass-fed. Lamb is also sold as 100% grass-fed but the site says it will offer its own lambs when they become available, so lamb left out of species; lamb is on a waitlist. Beef orders need a $299 deposit and go on a waiting list, up to 10 to 12 weeks. Pickup only at scheduled meat-up points (no shipping stated); sales_channels farm-pickup used for these. No drop-ins at the ranch. Second phone (602) 527-9369. Shop is on Shopify (datecreekranch.shop).
